purpose: Test representation invariance of the published winding-chain diagnostic on public PHerc0175A surface tracks; do not infer an anatomical winding sense.

selection.track_inclusion: all transverse tracks wholly in inclusive [7660,7740]; no image, ink label, or detector output consulted
selection.center_basis: geometric center of official 9363 x 9363 native image, deliberately not asserted to be the biological umbilicus

transformation_contract: When any track is reversed, both its self_local and all partner_local references are mapped to length-1-index. Coordinates are otherwise identical. Original global track IDs and longitudinal index distances are preserved. mirror_x changes only the x coordinate about the fixed center through the algorithm's mirror argument.
primary_gates: The fixed algorithm's ordered completed-start IDs, drift arrays, and summary statistics must be identical under the four storage-only transformations.
Report legacy results in all six conditions, even if no full turn completes; do not substitute another band or center after viewing the outcomes.
Analytic synthetic CW/ACW spirals must recover their known full-turn pitch within a declared 2-voxel rasterization tolerance and reverse physical sign under reflection.
The analytic taper counterexample must demonstrate that cross-height drift and a successful mirror sign check are insufficient evidence of anatomical sense.
real_data_mirror: Descriptive only. A greedy walk chooses different physical paths after reflection, so unpaired real-data counts need not negate exactly.
source_validation: Match track-store metadata source_db_signature to crossing metadata db_signature.
Verify source_ids alignment for every retained transverse track and every directly linked longitudinal track.
Range GETs must return HTTP 206, exact Content-Range and exact body length; reject changed ETags for an object.
Crossing members must be uncompressed ZIP_STORED, numeric non-object NumPy arrays in C order.
Retain all original crossing rows for the required nodes; no fabricated graph edge, padded CT, interpolation or silently missing source object.
outputs: Public code, tests, aggregate statistics, compact source receipts, hashes and methodological conclusions. Raw track arrays and per-chain coordinates remain outside git; no unread ink candidate is examined.
limitations: This is a software and geometry diagnostic, not an ink detector experiment, an independent anatomical validation, a reading or a prize claim.
Surface tracks are model-derived; exact intersections do not prove correct sheet identity.
The image center is not a validated umbilicus; no geometric sense verdict will be made from the real-data sign counts.
Chains share tracks and are dependent; no binomial significance or independent-sample confidence interval will be computed.
Synthetic defect and taper counterexample were discovered before this protocol. The real public coordinate subset has not yet been analyzed.
